original: Current direct request: X feed videos arranged 1,2,3 can play1 then3 while scrolling without playing2; investigate and repair.
evidence: Neutral three-row regression failed before the change: the adapter accepted the third source play although the second native player occupied the viewport center. The former adapter selected no within-pane media and its whole-column wheel token accepted any positive visible area. This proves an app-side ordering gap, not the exact current upstream X timing or repost-specific cause.
supersedes: The latest repair and retained original center-near autoplay request supersede source-only inline feed selection/no-play-call in the older readiness contract. Original immersive video/photo views and independent right preview still use native source behavior.
decisions: Keep original native X players, media URLs, controls, playback positions, mute and volume. No replacement UI/player, source click, fabricated URL, reload, navigation, private state or API.

Within one current primary feed column, group observed native players by actual outer article, independent of repost/author text. Prefer the displayed video interval nearest the clipped viewport center with24px boundary tolerance. A tall video is not penalized by a full-area visibility ratio.

Reject early off-center autoplay before consuming the wheel input token. After existing source playback intent, reconcile to the observed centered video using its own play method, only while native pane playback permission is granted. Native cross-pane account/registration/visibility/fullscreen priority remains authoritative.

Coalesce scroll, resize, source hydration and permission callbacks into a single60ms task. Bind to the same DOM root, route/history, input and visibility epoch; recheck owner/security/editing/native permission at execution. Cancel on intervening trusted input, revoked routing, account/login, history or concealment.

An explicit play may select a different visible row until the next scroll. Preserve current clip within a multi-video post. A trusted pointer/keyboard pause suppresses autoplay while the same row remains selected; explicit replay clears it.

Separate pause intent from other original-player controls: role=slider/native seeking temporary pauses do not suppress native resume. English/Korean pause controls, direct video toggles and K/Space retain explicit pause protection, including the pointerdown/click pair.

An observed centered poster reserves its row during hydration; do not click its source button or invent a media resource. Start only when a real permitted video source exists. Browser denial/errors/end do not create polling or repeated same-resource play attempts.
Large scroll jumps use the current viewport and may pass rows that are no longer visible. No forced playback of previously passed posts and no preload of every feed video.
acceptance: Forward and reverse ordering through the middle row
Tall and repost geometry; actual ancestor clipping
Wheel/native grant race and independent preview priority
Blocked/foreign/hidden/ad/stale ownership refusal; no retry loop or source-setting mutation
